sentences.text: This court, on 3rd November 2014, passed an interim direction to the respondents to permit the petitioner to shift the material to a private storage stating that the goods shall not be taken out for sale or marketing until further order of this court.

4. Now, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner brings to the notice of this court a proceedings dated 21.4.2015 passed by the Additional Commissioner of Customs (Group 1-4) stating that the request of the petitioner was accepted for re-export of the subject goods.

The relevant portion of the said order reads thus:-
"(i) I confiscate the offending goods valued at Rs.25,70,371.65/- imported by M/s.Vasta Biotech Pvt. Ltd., SVN House, No.10, C.P.Ramaswamy Aiyar Road,
Alwarpet, Chennai 600 018 vide Bill of Entry No.7119443 dated 20.10.2014 in terms of Section 111(d) of the Customs Act, 1962 read with provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

(ii) I give an option to the importer to redeem the goods on payment of redemption fine of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs only) under Section 125 of Customs Act,
1962 for the purpose of re-export only.

(iii) I also impose a personal penalty of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) on the importer under section 112(A) of Customs Act, 1962 for having rendered the goods liable for confiscation."
5.
In view of the above, the petitioner sought to withdraw both the writ petitions.

He has also made a request that since this court has already passed an interim direction to the respondent to permit the petitioner to shift the materials to a private storage, the said order may be extended till such time,
the petitioner re-exports the goods.
6. Accordingly, both the writ petitions are dismissed as withdrawn.
The above said direction will continue till such time the goods are re-exported as per the above said proceedings dated 21.4.2015.
Needless to mention that the re-export shall be done under the supervision of the respondent-Customs authorities.
No costs.
The connected miscellaneous petitions are also dismissed.
